messages:
Priya S.: Heads-up — Statera Corp legal needs 3 things to finish subscription: (1) SOC2 excerpts for user access & logging controls, (2) a simple network diagram for the Hosted POC showing public endpoints and staging allowlist, (3) a signed pentest attestation (they said no raw report). Deadline: Friday EOD.
Jordan L.: We can do redacted SOC2 snippets. For the pentest attestation, do they accept Security Director signature or insist on CISO?
Marco R.: Security Director works for most mid-market, unless they escalate. Also confirm scope sentence: "This attestation covers non-production demo environments and references prior third-party penetration testing; it is not a substitute for a full report."
Priya S.: Yep that's the wording I was about to propose. Also they asked about KMS — confirm: POC uses Redwood-managed keys, not customer KMS. I'll call that out.
Jordan L.: I'll assemble the docs and upload to evidence bucket. Will include a one-page network PNG and a CIDR allowlist example. ETA: Wednesday afternoon.
Marco R.: When you upload, create presigned links with 7-day expiry and include a short MD5 checksum for each file. Also add a line about data residency: "No customer data stored in EU region by default for Hosted POC unless customer requests EU region."
Priya S.: Noted. Quick ask: Statera asked if staging IPs are fixed or ephemeral. Answer: ephemeral but we can provide a current allowlist CIDR and update cadence (daily).
Jordan L.: Example presign command I'll use:
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/statera-poc/3865432100/soc2-access-excerpt.pdf --expires-in 604800
```
Marco R.: Good. I'll prepare the pen-test attestation template and route to Legal for a quick once-over. If Legal wants the CISO sig I'll flag immediately.
Priya S.: Please also include a short note for procurement: "POC is not a production SLA; Dedicated pricing and SLAs available upon purchase." Avoid technical jargon.
Jordan L.: Uploaded bundle: https://evidence.redwood.com/bundles/3865432100 (soc2-access-excerpt.pdf, network-diagram.png, pentest-attestation.pdf). Presigned links sent to buyer via secure channel.
evidence-bot: Evidence bundle created: https://evidence.redwood.com/bundles/3865432100 — expires 7 days.
Priya S.: Thanks team. I'll follow up with StateraLegal and confirm whether Security Director signature is sufficient. Will post update here. :white_check_mark:
